brief.headline: Blackstone-backed Aster DM eyes $150m India hospital deal
bullets: M&A & Buyouts: Blackstone-backed Aster DM Quality Care is in talks to acquire hospitals in northern India from rival Narayana Hrudayalaya in a deal that could be worth up to $150m, according to a report by Bloomberg.

Hotels & Hospitality: ARLINGTON, Texas—The Arlin, a Tribute Portfolio Hotel, opened its doors, marking the debut of a new lifestyle boutique hotel in Arlington, Texas, and the city’s only full-service Marriott property.

Infrastructure & Energy: Blue Owl Capital is preparing to issue $513m in commercial mortgage-backed securities (CMBS) to finance the acquisition of a northern Virginia data centre fully leased to Amazon, according to a report by Bloomberg.
Infrastructure & Energy: Trina Spear left Blackstone in 2013 to build a brand that started by selling scrubs out of the back of a car.

Regulation & Policy: The Securities and Exchange Commission today charged eight Colorado-based entities, likely operated by individuals located overseas, for defrauding U.S. investors out of more than $37 million.
brief.marketRead: Bottom line: signals are mixed, with some markets calm and others showing strain, so expect selective risk-taking. The S&P 500 stands at 7,323.63 (down 0.2% on the prior reading) and the VIX is 24.6, an elevated reading that signals nervous markets. The effective fed funds rate is 3.88%, the 10-year Treasury yield is 5.10% (down 2 bps on the prior reading) and the 10Y–2Y yield curve is +0.27 pts (positively sloped). High-yield credit spreads are 3.47%, near long-run norms (up 4 bps on the prior reading).
